function.description: Buy a Pendle yield token (YT) with a payment token — leveraged, VARIABLE yield exposure on the underlying until expiry. A YT DECAYS TO ZERO at expiry and is worth nothing after it; this is NOT fixed yield and can lose money if realized yield underperforms. Approval-gated; pins the canonical Pendle Router. REQUIRES a fresh matching pendle.yt.quote first.
function.name: pendle__yt_buy

amountIn.description: Amount of tokenIn in human-readable units.

chain.description: Chain slug or id — one of Pendle's 11 chains (e.g. 'ethereum', 'arbitrum', 'base', 'bsc').

tokenIn.description: Input token CONTRACT ADDRESS (ERC-20; use WETH for ETH). Buy: the payment token. Sell: the YT address.

tokenOut.description: Output token CONTRACT ADDRESS. Buy: the YT address. Sell: the payment token.
